results.title: Malformed lock (duplicate tag) rejected
results.summary: Accepted a P2PK secret with two locktime tags. NUT-11 says a duplicated tag makes the secret malformed and it MUST be rejected. Wallets and mints that read different copies of the tag disagree on when the refund key can spend, so a refund could open earlier than the receiver expects.

results.title: SIG_ALL signature covers the outputs
results.summary: Refused: a separate signature on each input's secret (SIG_INPUTS style); a SIG_ALL signature whose outputs were swapped after signing; accepted: one SIG_ALL signature over all inputs and outputs, in the first input

results.title: HTLC hash lock enforced
results.summary: Refused: no preimage, wrong preimage; accepted: correct preimage

results.title: HTLC receiver signature enforced
results.summary: Refused: preimage without the receiver's signature, preimage with the wrong signature; accepted: preimage and receiver signature

results.title: HTLC refund key blocked before locktime
results.summary: Refused: refund key before locktime, no preimage; accepted: preimage and receiver signature

results.title: HTLC refund works after locktime
results.summary: Refund key could not spend an expired HTLC without a preimage: HTTP 400 code=50000 Secret is not a HTLC secret. NUT-14 lets the sender reclaim with the refund signature alone once the locktime passes; on this mint a sender whose payment was never claimed cannot get it back.

results.title: Locked mint quote needs its signature
results.summary: The lock is enforced, but the mint only accepts the pre-May-2026 signature format and refused the current one (HTTP 400 code=20008 Signature missing or invalid). Up-to-date wallets cannot mint their locked quotes here.
